documents.text: Transit of Venus (opera) Transit of Venus is an opera in three acts by Victor Davies. The English libretto is by Canadian playwright Maureen Hunter based on her play of the same name first produced at the Manitoba Theatre Centre in November 1992. The opera was first performed by Manitoba Opera on November 24, 2007. The story is based on the expeditions of the 18th-century French astronomer, Guillaume le Gentil de la Galaisière.
